description: The line plot illustrates the trend of Pass@1 rate on Visual Navigation as the number of reasoning steps increases, comparing two models: GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis, labeled "Num. of Reasoning Steps," is linear, ranging from 5 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Pass@1 Rate (%)", is also linear, ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The line representing GPT-4o is solid, with circular markers, and shows a steep increase from 6.5% at 5 reasoning steps to 89.2% at 40 reasoning steps. The line representing Claude-3.5-Sonnet is dashed, with 'x' markers, and also shows a steep increase from 19.4% at 5 reasoning steps to 89.2% at 40 reasoning steps. Both lines plateau after 20 reasoning steps, with GPT-4o reaching 77.4% and Claude-3.5-Sonnet reaching 83.9%.
